purpose: One bounded exposed-development scratch-learning trial of external surface versus internal Foam path context; not full material-role learning or G1 acceptance.

labels.other_G0_edges: UNREVIEWED, not training negatives or accuracy denominators

split.N3_usage: Evaluate once after the final frozen training step; no selection, early stop or tuning on N3. Already exposed development, not a blind test.

operation.input: Complete native 7x7 RGB patches at saved G0 observed columns, centers y-5 and y+5. Use qualification complete_centers_xy; reject censored patches; one patch per listed center.
operation.preprocessing: RGB float32 / 255, no resize, CLAHE, padding, whitening or image-level normalization.
operation.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of 4 encoder channels across complete patches separately on upper and lower. Concatenate ordered means (8 values); no patch count, X/Y, case, frame, source, candidate family or answer as a model feature.
operation.availability: At least one complete patch on each side. Otherwise UNAVAILABLE; no zeros, repeated patches or invented path columns.
operation.dependency: Each latent patch value has exactly its 7x7 RGB footprint; the pooled decision uses the union of every retained patch. Geometry still comes from captured Canny with its original upstream context. Ordered sides are geometric context, not pure material classes.
operation.decision: argmax of the two final logits; exact tie UNKNOWN. No learned confidence threshold; this is an exploratory probe decision only.

training.initialization: torch Conv2d/Linear default initialization at the declared seed; no pretrained weights
training.loss: Mean of two fragment-level cross-entropies, equal weight N1/N2. No per-patch labels, regional pseudo-labels, auxiliary side-material loss or class reweighting.
training.schedule: constant; final step only, no checkpoint selection or validation-driven early stopping

execution.input_bridge: Existing saved qualification and RGB sources via NumPy/Pillow; training entry does not import G0/OpenCV. No environment clone or media copy.

evaluation.fit: N1 surface and N2 internal are training-fit checks, not independent efficacy.
evaluation.transfer: N3 external surface is only a one-direction positive transfer probe; report target loss/unknown separately.
evaluation.pass_criterion: No full G1 PASS is possible from this roster. If both fit checks and N3 transfer succeed, report LIMITED_EXPOSED_POSITIVE_TRANSFER only.
evaluation.failure: A fit failure or N3 wrong/unknown output closes this fixed trial without promotion; no seed, crop, offset, reference, cutoff, head size or learning-rate rescue.
unassessed: fine/coarse internal transitions outside the bound subjects

stop_rules: Stop on stale pins, missing side input, nonfinite loss/output or resource overrun; keep the reason, no input repair.
